logline: Publicly cast aside at the altar by Gerald for her sister Clarissa and abandoned by her own family, Juliana stands tall and turns her public humiliation into an unyielding indictment of Gerald's honor.

moments.description: Gerald publicly humiliates Juliana at the altar by cold-heartedly declaring he cannot marry her.
Gerald stands side by side with Clarissa and unfeelingly dismisses his broken promise.
moments.key_dialogue: Promises change when a better choice appears.

moments.description: Juliana's own father cruelly tells her to accept the public humiliation and not disgrace the family further.
moments.key_dialogue: Gerald has made his choice. Accept it, Juliana.

moments.description: Clarissa gloats over Juliana's plain gown and mocks her like a kitchen maid.
moments.key_dialogue: You look like a kitchen maid who wandered into the wrong wedding.

moments.description: Juliana sheds her tears and transforms her pain into a steely, defiant smile.
moments.key_dialogue: You abandoned a woman who trusted you...

moments.description: Juliana stands tall with unassailable dignity, delivering a scathing indictment of Gerald's honor as the orchestral score swells.
moments.key_dialogue: ...but I will not leave it believing I was the one who should be ashamed.
